items.name: Lumbridge Castle - Foundations and exterior build
Draynor Sewers
items.subtitle: The underground section connecting West Draynor with Draynor Jail. Complete with pipework and Ruantun's secret camp.
items.what:
09/06 - Completed the build, including Ruantun's camp within the ruined room.

Quest Complete!

items.name: HAM Hideout
items.subtitle:
Everything HAM, our first dungeon - Landscape, Foundations, Exterior, Interior and Decorations.

Making space for finding those Easy clues...

items.name: Lumbridge Swamp
items.subtitle: Lumbridge Swamp - in one big ticket. Much of this comprises the foundations of the swamp, making sure the pools and terrain are correct before populating with reeds and trees. Then, moving on to the houses, the Lumbridge caves, and decorations.
items.what:
04/05 - Finished Father Uhrney's house in the West swamp, and the mining area in the South-West corner.
23/06 - Finished landscaping the swamp, the house to Zanaris, and populating with foliage. We will pause on the slayer cave and move to Lumbridge before coming back to do this!

items.name: Draynor Village - Interior Build
items.subtitle: Interior decoration, QoL and final touches to all buildings and locations in and around Draynor Village
items.what:
14/05 - Bank and the Wise Old Man's house are now complete!
26/05 - Ned and Aggie's house also complete!
09/06 - Remaining houses and underground sewers complete!

Quest complete!

items.name: Draynor Village - Exterior Build
items.subtitle: Completing the exterior builds for all buildings in Draynor Village and surrounding areas
items.what:
06/05 -  Exteriors complete for all houses! Featuring the Bank, Ned's house and Aggie the Witch, as well as the market and the nearby farms. You can even try your luck at the agility course...

Quest complete!

items.name: Draynor Village - Landscaping & Foundations
items.subtitle: Landscaping, main paths and foundations of buildings for Draynor Village.
items.what:
05/05 - Village skeleton largely complete - terrain, paths and building foundations. Just need to plant the (many) trees and finish the remaining village paths before we can mark this as done!

12/05 - farm and wall exteriors built. Just some tree planting to go.

26/05 - trees, shrubs and remaining pathways complete.

Quest complete!

items.name: Update icons and web UI
items.subtitle: Update website: icons, added functionality for build ticket, changing the world view and image upload!

items.name: Share our first post on Substack!
items.subtitle: Write our first post on Substack - introduce ourselves and a bit about Project Runecraft
items.what:
Our first article is now live! Check it out!

Quest complete!

items.name: Wizard's Tower
items.subtitle: Our first building! Testing out WorldEdit on the Wizard's Tower near Draynor. Trialling a landscaping - foundation planning - walls and exterior - roof exterior - decorating exterior - designing interior - designing underground - placing lighting - finishing homely touches. Includes the connecting bridge with the STASH
items.what:
28/04 - Check out the pretty pictures! Landscaping, foundations, walls, exterior, roof and environment completed. Cycled through a couple of techniques and building materials for this. We now have some decent stencils (trees, walls, bricks, roads) we can copy to new buildings.

01/05 - Completed floors 1-3 interiors, lower ground in progress - choosing between a big catalogue of potential furnishings for future houses

04/05 - And we've finished our first proper feature! All floors are completed and decorated, including the minor island and faerie ring to the north.

Next stop - Draynor Village.

Quest complete!

items.name: Agree block palette
items.subtitle: Test out and agree palette for housing and landmarks across Misthalin.
items.what:
We've taken some time to familiarise ourselves with good palettes. Some things we've taken forward:

- Granite, limestone and gradienting them for exterior builds
- Mixing materials with connected textures for pathways.
- We've identified a bunch of cool interior objects - e.g. piles of books/rocks - and supporting beams.

We will figure this out as we go along, as each area will have its own needs. As far as we are concerned...

Quest complete!

items.name: Download supporting mods
items.subtitle: Figure out exactly what we need to build this well. Adding WorldEdit + supporting packs (CUI).
items.what:
25/04: Identified WorldEdit mod builds compatible with conquest reforged and trialled in sandbox by building a wizard’s tower POC.

27/04: Investigated Ardacraft's modpacks - some good content including Conquest:Architects and Conquest:Hearthfire (as well as minor packs). We decided not to include Create at this stage. We will use native tree functionality. 

04/05: Agreed on starting Modlist
- Conquest Architects
- Conquest Hearthfire
- Believe Mod
- Worldedit
- Worldedit CUI
- FTB Ultimine
- Xaero's Minimap
- Xaero's Worldmap

Quest Complete!

items.name: Identify foundation map
items.subtitle: Scout out different options for the foundation of Gielinor. Scan ProjectMC and forums for pre-designed terrain in WorldPainter.
items.what:
26/04: We’ve had a look at a few options for maps and found some great contenders. Major thanks to Mefisto148 for the excellent foundations of their map design, available on Curseforge - we will be building from this 👍

Quest complete!
